question: If P ∶ (Q + R) = 2 ∶ 5 and R ∶ (P + Q) = 6 ∶ 7, then find the value of Q ∶ (P + R)
solution:
**Given:**

P ∶ (Q + R) = 2 ∶ 5

R ∶ (P + Q) = 6 ∶ 7

**Formula used:**

Let P = 2k and (Q + R) = 5k

Let R = 6m and (P + Q) = 7m

**Calculation:**

P = 2k

⇒ Q + R = 5k

⇒ Q = 5k - R

R = 6m

⇒ P + Q = 7m

⇒ P = 7m - Q

Given P = 2k, so 2k = 7m - Q
